The [[Ice Beast]] is a [[Phantom (NPC)|Phantom]] [[boss]] that can be found in [[Mineral Springs]]. It is the equivalent of the [[Eidolon]], but is the only one found in an [[explorable area]].

== Locations ==
* [[Southern Shiverpeaks]]
** {{NPC location|Mineral Springs}}

== Skills ==
15 [[Water Magic]] (20 Water Magic in [[Hard mode]])
* {{skill icon|Aura of Restoration}}
* {{skill icon|Frozen Burst}}
* {{skill icon|Ice Prison}}
* {{skill icon|Mist Form}} ([[elite]])

== Items dropped ==
* [[Frozen Remnant]]
* [[Spectral Essence]]

== Notes ==
*Unlike [[Phantom (NPC)|Phantoms]], but like Eidolons, the Ice Beast is [[fleshy]].
* South of the Ice Beast's location there is a [[Seer]] who can [[Infusion|infuse]] any [[armor]] worn by the players in exchange for the [[Spectral Essence]] that the Ice Beast drops.
* [[Azure Shadow]]s spawn around the Ice Beast.
* Does not spawn during the quest [[Defend Droknar's Forge]].  The Seer does not spawn either.
